concerns.location: tasks.md:FR coverage note vs spec.md:FR-002, FR-003
concerns.text: FR-002 (ISRIC merge, 10 km NN interpolation) and FR-003's k-NN imputation (k=5, mean fallback) have NO covering task — they are dropped via the AM-001 deviation while the active spec still mandates them. tasks.md: 'FR-002 (excluded per AM-001 deviation record)'. A deviation record is not a task; either add a spec-amendment task or a task covering the FRs as written.

concerns.location: tasks.md:FR coverage note vs spec.md:FR-023, SC-001
concerns.text: SC-001/FR-023 (`merge_success_rate` ≥ 0.90 against RootReader/PlantPheno) is 'redefined per AM-001' as `pn_availability_rate` with no task amending the spec. The redefinition exists only in a completed-work note; no pending task reconciles spec SC-001 with what is actually measured.

T104 must write `required_n_per_species` and an SC-009 status into `model_metrics.json` under `success_criteria`, but the active model_results.schema.yaml `success_criteria` block contains only sc_002_met/sc_003_met/sc_006_met/power_achieved with `additionalProperties: false` at the top level. No task extends the schema, so T104's output will fail T103's contract validation. Add a schema-extension subtask or fold it into T103.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Completed work (n≥20 filtering) vs spec.md:FR-024, SC-009, plan.md:T010
concerns.text: FR-024/SC-009 require confirming the filtered dataset meets ≥30 observations per species, but the completed ingestion filters at n≥20 and no pending task (T104 only records power given 'the filtered dataset's minimum per-species count') enforces or even checks the ≥30 threshold. Coverage of FR-024's confirmation clause is incomplete.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Path Conventions vs plan.md:T033, Constitution III
concerns.text: Plan T033 requires SHA-256 checksums of raw data files recorded in state; tasks.md states research scripts do NOT write `state/`, and no pending task covers raw-data checksumming under `data/` as Constitution III requires ('checksummed and the checksum recorded under `data/`'). The checksum requirement has no covering task in the current task list.

T110's verification command runs `python code/data_ingestion.py` but quickstart.md documents `python code/ingestion.py`. One of the two is wrong; the end-to-end validation task cannot be executed as written.
